why: Pre-execution command inspection blocks destructive and exfiltration attempts before they reach the guest, providing defense in depth beyond prompts.
Restricting guest egress prevents unauthorized data exfiltration during containment tests, proving isolation from the host network.
Attaches native Celesto Callback hooks (on_pre_run, on_post_run, on_run_error) to intercept and log in-flight agent commands deterministically before they execute on the guest.
Provides point-in-time full guest microVM snapshotting and instant restoration to checkpoint state before risky agent operations and eliminate cold-start overhead.
